{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace SemVerSolver

inductive Version where
  | core (major minor patch : Nat)
  | pre (major minor patch : Nat) (ids : List (Option Nat))

inductive ConstraintOp where
  | eq
  | gt
  | ge
  | lt
  | le

structure Constraint where
  op : ConstraintOp
  version : Version

structure InputData where
  available : List String
  constraints : List Constraint
  includePrerelease : Bool

structure OutputData where
  eligible : List String
  selected : Option String

def parseVersion (s : String) : Option Version :=
  let parts := s.splitOn '.'
  if parts.length = 3 then
    match parts[0]!, parts[1]!, parts[2]! with
    | ⟨major, rest1⟩, ⟨minor, rest2⟩, ⟨patch, rest3⟩ =>
      if major.isdigit && minor.isdigit && patch.isdigit then
        let majorN := major.toNat
        let minorN := minor.toNat
        let patchN := patch.toNat
        if rest1.isEmpty && rest2.isEmpty && rest3.isEmpty then
          some (Version.core majorN minorN patchN)
        else
          let prePart := rest1 ++ rest2 ++ rest3
          if prePart[0]! = '-' then
            let preStr := prePart.drop 1
            let ids := preStr.splitOn '-'.map fun id =>
              if id.isdigit then some id.toNat else none
            some (Version.pre majorN minorN patchN ids)
          else
            none
      else
        none
    else
      none
  else
    none

def versionPrecedence (v : Version) : List (Option Nat) :=
  match v with
  | Version.core major minor patch => [some major, some minor, some patch, some 1]
  | Version.pre major minor patch ids => [some major, some minor, some patch, some 0, some ids.length]

def comparePrecedence (a b : Version) : Bool :=
  let pa := versionPrecedence a
  let pb := versionPrecedence b
  let len := max pa.length pb.length
  let rec loop (i : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i < len then
      let ea := if i < pa.length then pa[i]! else none
      let eb := if i < pb.length then pb[i]! else none
      match ea, eb with
      | some x, some y => if x < y then true else if x > y then false else loop (i + 1)
      | some _, none => false
      | none, some _ => true
      | none, none => loop (i + 1)
    else
      false
  loop 0

def satisfiesConstraint (v : Version) (c : Constraint) : Bool :=
  let pv := versionPrecedence v
  let pc := versionPrecedence c.version
  let len := max pv.length pc.length
  let rec loop (i : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i < len then
      let ea := if i < pv.length then pv[i]! else none
      let eb := if i < pc.length then pc[i]! else none
      match ea, eb with
      | some x, some y =>
        match c.op with
        | ConstraintOp.eq => if x = y then loop (i + 1) else false
        | ConstraintOp.gt => if x > y then true else if x < y then false else loop (i + 1)
        | ConstraintOp.ge => if x > y then true else if x < y then false else loop (i + 1)
        | ConstraintOp.lt => if x < y then true else if x > y then false else loop (i + 1)
        | ConstraintOp.le => if x < y then true else if x > y then false else loop (i + 1)
      | some _, none => false
      | none, some _ => true
      | none, none => loop (i + 1)
    else
      true
  loop 0

def isPrerelease (v : Version) : Bool :=
  match v with
  | Version.core _ _ _ => false
  | Version.pre _ _ _ _ => true

def solve (input : InputData) : OutputData :=
  let availableVersions := input.available.filterMap parseVersion
  let eligibleVersions := availableVersions.filter fun v =>
    (input.constraints.all (fun c => satisfiesConstraint v c)) &&
    (input.includePrerelease || !isPrerelease v)
  let eligibleStrings := input.available.filter fun s =>
    match parseVersion s with
    | some v => eligibleVersions.contains v
    | none => false
  let deduped := eligibleStrings.filter fun s =>
    let idx := eligibleStrings.indexOf s
    idx.isSome && (idx.get! == s)
  let sorted := deduped.sort (fun a b =>
    match parseVersion a, parseVersion b with
    | some va, some vb =>
      if comparePrecedence va vb then true
      else if comparePrecedence vb va then false
      else a < b
    | _, _ => a < b
  )
  let selected := if sorted.isEmpty then none else some sorted.last!
  { eligible := sorted, selected := selected }

def validInput (input : InputData) : Prop :=
  input.available.all (fun s =>
    match parseVersion s with
    | some _ => true
    | none => false
  )

def validOutput (output : OutputData) : Prop :=
  output.eligible.all (fun s =>
    match parseVersion s with
    | some _ => true
    | none => false
  )

def nonVacuity : Prop :=
  ∃ (input : InputData), validInput input ∧
    let output := solve input
    validOutput output ∧
    (output.eligible.isEmpty ↔ output.selected = none) ∧
    (output.eligible.Nonempty → output.selected.isSome)

theorem thm_O1 (input : InputData) (h : validInput input) :
  let output := solve input
  ∃ (e : List String) (s : Option String), output.eligible = e ∧ output.selected = s := by
  sorry

theorem thm_O2 (input : InputData) (h : validInput input) :
  let output := solve input
  output.eligible.all (fun s =>
    input.available.contains s ∧
    (match parseVersion s with
     | some v => input.constraints.all (fun c => satisfiesConstraint v c) ∧
                 (input.includePrerelease || !isPrerelease v)
     | none => false)
  ) := by
  sorry

theorem thm_O3 (input : InputData) (h : validInput input) :
  let output := solve input
  output.eligible.all (fun s =>
    let idx := output.eligible.indexOf s
    idx.isSome ∧ (idx.get! == s)
  ) := by
  sorry

theorem thm_O4 (input : InputData) (h : validInput input) :
  let output := solve input
  output.eligible.pairwise (fun a b =>
    match parseVersion a, parseVersion b with
    | some va, some vb => comparePrecedence va vb ∨ (comparePrecedence va vb = false ∧ comparePrecedence vb va = false ∧ a ≤ b)
    | _, _ => a ≤ b
  ) := by
  sorry

theorem thm_O5 (input : InputData) (h : validInput input) :
  let output := solve input
  output.eligible.pairwise (fun a b =>
    match parseVersion a, parseVersion b with
    | some va, some vb =>
      if comparePrecedence va vb then true
      else if comparePrecedence vb va then false
      else a ≤ b
    | _, _ => a ≤ b
  ) := by
  sorry

theorem thm_O6 (input : InputData) (h : validInput input) :
  let output := solve input
  output.eligible.Nonempty →
    match output.selected with
    | some s =>
      match parseVersion s with
      | some vs =>
        output.eligible.all (fun t =>
          match parseVersion t with
          | some vt => comparePrecedence vt vs ∨ (comparePrecedence vt vs = false ∧ comparePrecedence vs vt = false ∧ t ≤ s)
          | none => false
        )
      | none => false
    | none => false := by
  sorry

theorem thm_O7 (input : InputData) (h : validInput input) :
  let output := solve input
  output.eligible.Nonempty →
    match output.selected with
    | some s =>
      match parseVersion s with
      | some vs =>
        output.eligible.all (fun t =>
          match parseVersion t with
          | some vt =>
            if comparePrecedence vt vs then true
            else if comparePrecedence vs vt then false
            else s ≤ t
          | none => false
        )
      | none => false
    | none => false := by
  sorry

theorem thm_O8 (input : InputData) (h : validInput input) :
  let output := solve input
  output.eligible.isEmpty → output.selected = none := by
  sorry

theorem thm_I1 (a b : Version) :
  comparePrecedence a b ∨ comparePrecedence b a ∨ (comparePrecedence a b = false ∧ comparePrecedence b a = false) := by
  sorry

theorem thm_I2 (v : Version) (c : Constraint) :
  satisfiesConstraint v c ↔
    match c.op with
    | ConstraintOp.eq => comparePrecedence v c.version = false ∧ comparePrecedence c.version v = false
    | ConstraintOp.gt => comparePrecedence c.version v
    | ConstraintOp.ge => comparePrecedence c.version v ∨ (comparePrecedence c.version v = false ∧ comparePrecedence v c.version = false)
    | ConstraintOp.lt => comparePrecedence v c.version
    | ConstraintOp.le => comparePrecedence v c.version ∨ (comparePrecedence v c.version = false ∧ comparePrecedence c.version v = false) := by
  sorry

theorem non_vacuity : nonVacuity := by
  sorry

end SemVerSolver",
